image_description: A modern architectural staircase featuring a metal bannister system. The structure includes sleek, tubular stainless steel handrails supported by vertical cylindrical balusters and thicker newel posts anchored into concrete bases. The stairs themselves are wide with light-colored stone or concrete treads, leading up to a landing with wooden paneling in the background.
